test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about Ayushman Bharat Scheme (ABS)?

options.text: Senior Citizen Health Insurance Scheme (SCHIS) is not covered under the scheme.
The scheme will have a defined benefit cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year.
Ayushman Bharat is a National Health Protection Scheme.
Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) has been subsumed under Ayushman Bharat Scheme (ABS).

solution:
The correct answer is __**Senior Citizen Health Insurance Scheme (SCHIS) is not covered under the scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Health Insurance Company** offers a Varishtha Mediclaim policy that offers medical insurance coverage to senior citizens between the age group of years and **80 years. **
 
• A senior citizen's medical insurance coverage is designed for human beings above the age of **60 years.**
 
• The policy is available for sums insured of** Rs 1 lakh, Rs 2 lakh, Rs 3 lakh, Rs 4 lakh, and Rs 5 lakh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayushman Bharat Yojana scheme **offers health insurance coverage to beneficiaries without any premium cost or treatment costs during and after the hospitalization. 
 
• **Ayushman Bharat scheme** covers each pre and publish-hospitalization charge further to the in-patient costs.
 
• Ayushman Bharat scheme was launched by the Prime Minister, Sh. Narendra Modi on** September 23rd, 2018 **as a progressive step towards achieving UHC in India.
 
• Families with no individuals aged between **16 and 59 years.**
